notes.transcription: best_match and era5 (2017+) were transcribed from the browser in chunks with per-chunk sum/count checksums, all matched; best_match annual sums 1995-2025 identical to rain_rio.json annual.by_year.
notes.derived: era5 1995-2016 and ecmwf_ifs 2017+ were not transcribed separately: in the browser they were identical to best_match on every day of those periods (0 differing days; total sums matched).
notes.era5_land: API returned 200 with all-null precipitation_sum for this point, cell_selection=land, and (-22.9,-43.25); CSV has empty values only.

columns.cloud_cover_mean_pct: daily mean of 24 hourly total cloud cover, % (API: cloud_cover_mean)
columns.sunshine_min: sunshine_duration/60, rounded to minutes (WMO: direct normal irradiance > 120 W/m2)
columns.cloud_daytime_0917_pct: mean of hourly cloud_cover for local hours 09:00..17:00 (9 values, America/Sao_Paulo), 1 decimal; computed in the browser from the hourly API

notes.transcription: fetched in the user's browser and transferred in 4 chunks of <=3000 days, base36-encoded, per-chunk column sums verified exactly in Python (one dropped row in chunk 3 was found by block checksums and fixed before verification).
notes.nulls: 2026-11-06..2026-11-11 are null in the daily series (as in precipitation); hourly exists for 2026-11-06 but cloud_daytime is blanked there to keep the series aligned with the daily nulls.
